cases.sentence: Здесь они обнаружили, что ___ от входа в гробницу отвален.
cases.translation: Here they discovered that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance to the tomb.
cases.explain: Камень is the grammatical subject of the clause, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Здесь они обнаружили, что камень от ___ в гробницу отвален.
cases.translation: Here they discovered that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance to the tomb.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from, away from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Те сказали им, что Господь действительно воскрес и явился ___.
cases.translation: They told them that the Lord had indeed risen and appeared to Simon.
cases.explain: The verb явился (appeared to someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они видели ___ и то, как тело Иисуса было положено в нее.
cases.translation: They saw the tomb and how Jesus's body was laid in it.
cases.explain: Гробницу is the direct object of видели (to see), so it takes the accusative case.
The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Они увидели, что рядом с ними вдруг появились два человека в сияющих ___.
cases.translation: They saw that two men in shining garments suddenly appeared beside them.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Войдя внутрь, они не нашли тело Господа Иисуса.
reading.question: What did the women find when they entered the tomb?
options: They did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
They found the disciples waiting inside
They found Roman soldiers guarding it
reading.correct: They did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
reading.explain: Entering the tomb, the women did not find the Lord Jesus's body.

reading.ru: Что вы ищете живого среди мертвых?
reading.question: What did the two men in shining clothes ask the women?
options: "Why do you seek the living among the dead?"
reading.correct: "Why do you seek the living among the dead?"
reading.explain: The two men asked the women why they sought the living among the dead.

reading.ru: Петр, однако же, побежал к гробнице.
reading.question: Who ran to the tomb after hearing the women's report?
reading.explain: The text says Peter ran to the tomb.

reading.ru: В тот же день двое из учеников шли в селение Эмаус, что расположено в шестидесяти стадиях от Иерусалима, и говорили обо всем, что произошло.
reading.question: Where were the two disciples walking on the road?
options: To the village of Emmaus, sixty stadia from Jerusalem
reading.correct: To the village of Emmaus, sixty stadia from Jerusalem
reading.explain: The two disciples were walking to Emmaus, sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Один из них, которого звали Клеопа, ответил
reading.question: What was the name of one of the two disciples on the road to Emmaus?
reading.explain: The text names one of the two disciples as Cleopas.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал им, «Как же вы глупы, как медленно вы соображаете, чтобы верить всему, что предсказали пророки».
reading.question: How did Jesus describe the disciples' understanding?
options: Foolish and slow to believe the prophets
reading.correct: Foolish and slow to believe the prophets
reading.explain: Jesus called them foolish and slow of heart to believe the prophets.

reading.ru: За столом Иисус взял хлеб, благословил его, разломил и дал им.
reading.question: What did Jesus do at the table in Emmaus that revealed his identity?
options: He took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them
He read from the Torah aloud
reading.correct: He took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them
reading.explain: At the table Jesus took bread, blessed and broke it, and their eyes were opened.

reading.ru: Они встали и сразу же пошли обратно в Иерусалим.
reading.question: What did the two disciples do immediately after recognizing Jesus?
options: They got up and went back to Jerusalem at once
reading.correct: They got up and went back to Jerusalem at once
reading.explain: They rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Они замерли в испуге, думая, что видят призрак.
reading.question: How did the disciples react when Jesus appeared among them in Jerusalem?
options: They were terrified, thinking they saw a ghost
They ran out of the room
reading.correct: They were terrified, thinking they saw a ghost
reading.explain: The disciples were frightened, supposing they saw a spirit.

reading.ru: Он взял и ел перед ними.
reading.question: What did Jesus do to prove to the disciples that he was not a ghost?
options: He ate broiled fish in front of them
He flew up into the sky
He spoke in a foreign tongue
reading.correct: He ate broiled fish in front of them
reading.explain: Jesus took the piece of fish they gave him and ate it in front of them.

reading.ru: И в то время, как он благословлял их, он стал отдаляться от них и поднялся на небеса.
reading.question: What happened as Jesus blessed the disciples near Bethany?
options: He was taken up into heaven
reading.correct: He was taken up into heaven
reading.explain: While blessing them, Jesus withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
